in_marathi.name: Pranjali
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lotus in hand
in_marathi.long_meaning: Pranjali हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A beautiful Hindu girl name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Pran' which means 'life' and 'Jali' which means 'lotus'. The name 'Pranjali' symbolizes the goddess Lakshmi, who is known to hold a lotus flower in her hand.
